opening.argument: The speaker promises Bitcoin commissions from mining that runs continuously, saying viewers can generate income without doing anything. She identifies herself as part of a team offering this business opportunity and invites viewers to participate in the crypto business. Repeated displays of a Bitcoin-specific website and BitClub Network branding reinforce that promotion. These elements establish an active solicitation of passive mining-related income: the speaker is advancing a scam business opportunity through an effortless-income claim, rather than reporting, criticizing, or neutrally explaining it.

citations.quote: the mining is working 24 hours straight... we are creating commissions in Bitcoin and you can generate income with no need to do anything
I am part of a team that is helping me and giving me tools to offer this business opportunity
